summary: Release 2.6 revision 6 is READY_TO_FREEZE. GLM 5.3 independently accepted the exact revision-6 digest in session ses_fc30730b5ffe3z2z3VSzFH2OK3. Grok 4.6 xhigh independently confirmed closure of the revision-5 publication ownership gap and all three Low precision findings, verified non-executability before review and lock, and found no new Medium or High issue. The plan remains bound to accepted Release 2.5 merge a3abc26296bb9f4535910beaaf09a78e1bd8cac2.

dimensions.rationale: All six requirements map to six acceptance criteria, six evidence routes, one owning workstream each and matching final-audit gates.
All 54 write paths are uniquely owned. WS26-03 includes both install guides and every publication-contract path required for 2.6.0.
Focused and full tests, the tracked continuity fixture, locked Python quality, dependency, complexity, documentation, neutrality and publication routes are explicit and executable.
Lock creation requires an independent digest-bound report, uses the canonical no-replace path, verifies package inventory and grants no authority from a status string alone.
The plan preserves unavailable telemetry, separates wall and additive compute, binds provenance, enforces explicit bounded sources and adds no model, host or network authority.
planReview.report and planFiles predeclare plan-review-r6.json, reviewedRevision equals planRevision 6, reviewedPlanHash matches the unchanged manifest digest, and no lock existed during review.

findings.message: Revision 5 omitted two install guides required by the publication version and adoption contracts.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 6 assigns both English and Russian install guides to WS26-03 and preserves unique ownership.

findings.message: Revision 5 required a phase-count cap without naming its value.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 6 fixes MAX_PHASE_RESOURCE_ENTRIES at 256 and requires 256/257 boundary evidence in builder and validator paths.

findings.message: Inline lock-create handling risked exceeding the hard function-size gate in dispatch_planning.py.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 6 assigns a dedicated cli/plan_lock_commands.py helper to WS26-01.

findings.message: Revision 5 did not name or own the no-model handoff fixture.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 6 names, owns and explicitly runs tests/planning/test_continuity.py.

findings.message: The future lock-create implementation must read verdict, independence and findings from the report file, never from manifest.planReview.verdict.
findings.requiredAction: Verify this invariant during WS26-01 implementation audit.

findings.message: The phase bound is a to-be contract and is not present on the Release 2.5 base.
findings.requiredAction: Define MAX_PHASE_RESOURCE_ENTRIES exactly once as 256 and enforce it in builder and validator with boundary tests.
